sceneScope: Illustrative workflows, not engineering or political simulations

plant.authoritativeState: selected workstream plus section scroll progress; phone uses a layer slider
plant.behaviour: selected group separates with progress; nonselected groups settle at assembly height; Overview coordinates all groups
plant.continuity: existing group transforms interpolate to new targets without scene recreation or scroll reset
plant.reference: user-provided generated plant image, used for palette/composition only

landsafe.geometry: authored fictional extruded parcel, fixed survey markers, comparison line, textured generic paper panels
landsafe.grounding: source-backed report categories and document workflow; no client case reproduced

research.geometry: authored tabletop, separated notes, paper stacks, folder with bound-edge cover pivot
research.grounding: confirmed research/briefing responsibilities; separate nomination portfolio summary

lighting.finish: matte sage and cream; subdued brass; existing plant silver
lighting.animation: no moving lights, fixed exposure and camera

accessibility: SVG fallback for both new scenes
static plant poster with fallback notice
privacy: Only manually composed anonymized summaries and generic texture labels shipped. Originals remain outside public assets.
rendering: near-viewport lazy loading; request frames during state changes; stop once settled, hidden, or off-screen
assets: custom geometry and existing dependencies; no third-party models or source-document textures
